categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes src/interfaces/wallet.h only to expose transaction rebroadcast eligibility to the GUI; category guidelines state adding a method to interfaces::Wallet for wallet/GUI functionality is not ipc unless interface mechanics are the point.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Implements manual rebroadcasting logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and adds the rebroadcastwallettx RPC in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds a direct RPC and GUI mechanism to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions that failed to propagate or dropped from mempools. As noted in the description, users currently face the friction of having to manually extract transaction hex and invoke sendrawtransaction.
